lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ba₂Cu₄O₈ (reduced formula BaCu₂O₄) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 119), with 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies tetrahedral Cu centers coordinated by four O neighbors, and octahedral Ba centers coordinated by six O neighbors; these coordination environments show corner-sharing between Cu tetrahedra and Ba octahedra and among Cu tetrahedra, as well as edge-sharing between Ba octahedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 14 sites.
